title: Robert Maxwell and Nazi tech transfer

tellings.quote: basically like helped invent peer review, scientific peer review, was also in charge of Nazi tech transfer

plain: A man named Robert Maxwell is said to have helped invent scientific peer review, the system where experts check research before it is published. Michels adds that Maxwell was also in charge of "Nazi tech transfer", moving German wartime technology into other hands. He says this himself, without naming a source, and suggests that one man held both science publishing and captured technology.
